data.narrative:
Dispatch Space is an undisclosed-stage private company in Space & Aerospace, founded by Payton Case and Andrew Mello. The sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs. This universe is broad but fragmented across development stages and business models.

Conventional valuation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the private set—14 total Space & Aerospace peers exist, but none of the narrow filters (stage alignment, valuation tier) yielded 3+ datapoints necessary for reliable median pricing. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales also cannot proceed: the sector median P/S is 25.3x across the 6 public tickers, but Dispatch Space's revenue remains undisclosed, as is typical for private companies, rendering any multiple application speculative.

Without disclosed revenue, stage clarity, or a sufficiently dense peer cohort at comparable development tiers, no quantitative valuation range is defensible from the available data. Any conclusion would require either: (1) Dispatch Space's own financial metrics; (2) narrower stage/business-model alignment within the private peer set; or (3) direct transaction data. The analyst should flag this data gap rather than force a triangulation that lacks supporting evidence.
